topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: So, my so-called best friend decides to up and leave, moving across the country like it’s nothing. Just a casual announcement, tossed out there like it’s some everyday piece of news. Years we’ve spent together, and now it’s just...over? No big deal, right? I’m supposed to just smile and say, “That’s great for you”? Like I’m supposed to be happy? They talk about new beginnings and adventures, and all I can think about is the gaping hole this is going to leave. But of course, the show must go on. I’ll nod and pretend it’s just fine, because that’s what good friends do, even when it feels like everything is falling apart.
